bias.zh: 反弹 · 失守 $196，守住 10 日均线

read.en: Arm fell 4.6% on Nov 13 to $190.53, trading $180.50–199.39. It is below the 5-day ($192.3), just above the 10-day ($189.4) and below the 30-day ($225.8), 100-day ($261.8) and 200-day ($232.8); the 5-day and 200-day are rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 12, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($207.44), and RSI is 40.6.
read.zh: Arm 11月13日下跌 4.6%，收于 $190.53，盘中区间 $180.50–199.39。股价位于 5 日均线（$192.3）下方，略高于 10 日均线（$189.4），位于 30 日（$225.8）、100 日（$261.8）和 200 日均线（$232.8）下方；5 日和 200 日均线在上行。MACD 于 11月12日上穿信号线，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$207.44），RSI 为 40.6。

read.en: The close lost the $196.1–196.8 support (Nov 2 low and close), now resistance; the close held the 10-day. Resistance is $192.3–196.8 (5-day, Nov 2), then $199.4–204.8 (Nov 13 and 12 highs) and $207.4–209.5 (SAR, Nov 4 high). Support is $188.4–189.9 (10-day, Nov 4 and 11 lows), then $180.5–181.5 and $174.6–175.8. A close above $196.8 would target $204.8–207.4; below $188.4, $180.5–181.5.
